crossRefs.note: He came to Derbe and Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed…
and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you…
Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good…
Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News…
I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering.They washed their…
But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

translations.web: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
translations.bsb: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.
translations.kjv: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
translations.asv: Know ye that our brother Timothy hath been set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
